_comment: Example servers catalogue (the /servers response — a stand-in for the DB-connection API). Copy to servers.json (or any path) and point OLS_SERVERS_FILE at it. Key format: {db_source}_{server_type}_{server_name}; each value is a list of rows, one per base_log_path. Every base_log_path must sit inside OLS_LOG_ROOT. Omit this file entirely to browse the whole OLS_LOG_ROOT via one generic 'localhost' server.
